You answer a question about machinery and work-equipment law using ONLY the numbered facts given.
Each fact has a subject, a relation, a value (as written, then in normal form in brackets), sometimes a condition,
and the place it comes from. Some facts carry a note computed from the dates: trust the notes.

Rules:
- Use only these facts. Do not use anything you know from elsewhere.
- If the facts do not answer the question, the kind is "unknown" and the value is null.
- A condition attached to a fact is part of the fact: carry it into the answer.
- If the question asks about a day, compare that day with every date in the facts, one by one, before you answer.
  A repeal, a limit or an application "from" a date takes effect on that date, not earlier: an act repealed from a
  date is still fully in force, with everything it permits, on every earlier day; a rule applying from a date does
  not yet bind on earlier days.
- If a note says that a date quoted in a condition was corrected, reason with the corrected date.
- If the question asks "which" or "what" and several facts answer it, list every one of them, in the words of the
  facts, one item per fact. Facts filed under the same article, annex part or numbered point belong together.
  When the answer is a group named by an article or an annex part and the facts list the members of that group,
  give the members, not the name of the group.
- A fact noted as "filed under a place the question names" belongs to the answer of a "which / what" question
  about that place whenever its relation fits the question: list all of them, not one.
- Lines under "Computed by rule" are results worked out in code from the numbered facts they name: trust them,
  give their result as the answer for the device asked about, and put the fact numbers they name in "used".
- Include only what the question asks for: no neighbouring item, no other regime that the question did not ask
  about. An option that combines several things in sequence is one item, not several.
- A fact about a neighbouring subject (another paragraph, another device, another kind of verification, another
  product, another deadline) does not answer the question. When the exact subject asked about is absent from the
  facts, "unknown" is the correct answer: do not answer from the nearest fact.
- For a "who" question, when one fact, or several facts with the same subject and relation, name several bodies,
  all of them are the answer together: name each one.
- For "which categories / which items listed in a place", the answer is the members filed under that place, each
  in the words of its fact, without adding the place to the item.
- For "which risks / which hazards does a numbered point address", use every fact filed under that point whatever
  its relation: a measure is required against a risk, and its subject and condition name that risk.
- Never return a list for a "text" answer: a question that one sentence answers (who, why, how, under which
  condition, which one thing and why) gets one short sentence. "Which / what / list all" of several things is "set".
- The kind follows the question: "from which date / when (a day)" is "date"; "for how long" alone is "duration";
  "can / may / is / does" is "boolean"; "which / what (several things)" is "set"; who, why, under which condition,
  or who does something and within what time is "text", and the text names every element asked for.
- Return JSON only, with the reasoning first:
  {"reasoning": "the facts and dates compared, step by step, in a few short sentences",
   "kind": "set|date|duration|boolean|text|unknown",
   "value": <list of short strings for set | "YYYY-MM-DD" for date | ISO 8601 duration like "P10Y" | true/false | a short text | null>,
   "text": "one or two sentences for a person, naming the article or annex point",
   "used": [fact numbers you relied on]}

Today is 2026-11-14.
Question: Who is considered the manufacturer after a substantial modification of machinery?

Facts:
[0] Person carrying out substantial modification — is subject to — Article 10 manufacturer obligations for the modified machinery or related product (Article 10 manufacturer obligations for the modified machinery or related product) [REG, Art. 18]
[1] Person carrying out substantial modification — is subject to — Article 10 manufacturer obligations for only the affected part of an assembly (Article 10 manufacturer obligations for only the affected part of an assembly) [condition: substantial modification has an impact on the safety of only a machinery or related product that is part of an assembly, as demonstrated in the risk assessment] [REG, Art. 18]
[2] A natural or legal person — carries out substantial modification — considered a manufacturer for purposes of this Regulation (considered a manufacturer for purposes of this Regulation) [REG, Art. 18]
[3] Manufacturers — takeAccountOf — changes in the design or characteristics of the partly completed machinery (changes in the design or characteristics of the partly completed machinery) [REG, Art. 11(4)]
[4] substantial modification — meansModificationOf — machinery or a related product (machinery or a related product) [condition: modification made by physical or digital means after the product has been placed on the market or put into service] [REG, Art. 3(16)]
[5] manufacturer — isDefinedAs — a person who designs and/or manufactures machinery and is responsible for its conformity with the Directive before it is placed on the market (a person who designs and/or manufactures machinery and is responsible for its conformity with the Directive before it is placed on the market) [condition: in the absence of a manufacturer, any person who places on the market or puts into service machinery is considered the manufacturer] [DIR, Art. 2]
[6] Person carrying out substantial modification — must ensure and declare — machinery or related product is in conformity with applicable requirements of this Regulation (machinery or related product is in conformity with applicable requirements of this Regulation) [condition: on its sole responsibility] [REG, Art. 18]
[7] Manufacturers — shall ensure partly completed machinery bears — its designation as partly completed machinery (its designation as partly completed machinery) [REG, Art. 11(5)]
[8] Modifiche apportate alle macchine — non comportano — modifiche delle modalità di utilizzo e delle prestazioni previste dal costruttore (modifiche delle modalità di utilizzo e delle prestazioni previste dal costruttore) [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 5]
[9] Non-professional user — is not considered — a manufacturer for purposes of this Regulation (a manufacturer for purposes of this Regulation) [condition: substantially modifies own machinery or related product for own use] [REG, Art. 18]
[10] Manufacturers — shallIndicateOn — partly completed machinery (partly completed machinery) [REG, Art. 11(6)]
[11] the manufacturer — assumesResponsibilityFor — compliance of the partly completed machinery with the requirements laid down in this Regulation (compliance of the partly completed machinery with the requirements laid down in this Regulation) [condition: by drawing up the EU declaration of incorporation] [REG, Art. 22(4)]
[12] Modifiche apportate alle macchine — non configurano — immissione sul mercato ai sensi dell'articolo 1, comma 3, secondo periodo (immissione sul mercato ai sensi dell'articolo 1, comma 3, secondo periodo) [condition: sempre che non comportino modifiche delle modalità di utilizzo e delle prestazioni previste dal costruttore] [DLGS71, art. 71, c. 5]
[13] Manufacturers — shall ensure machinery bears — a designation of model, series or type (a designation of model, series or type) [REG, Art. 10(5)]
[14] modification — isNotForeseenOrPlannedBy — the manufacturer (the manufacturer) [condition: the modification must also affect safety to qualify as substantial] [REG, Art. 3(16)]
[15] EC declaration of conformity — identifiesModifiedProduct — substantially modified machinery or related product (substantially modified machinery or related product) [condition: the machinery has been substantially modified] [REG, Annex V, Part A, point 1]
[16] Manufacturer or authorised representative — must envisage reasonably foreseeable misuse — when designing and constructing machinery and drafting instructions (when designing and constructing machinery and drafting instructions) [DIR, Annex I, 1.1.2]
[17] Manufacturers — shall take account of — changes in the production process, in the design or characteristics of the machinery, and in the harmonised standards, other technical specifications, or common specifications used to declare conformity (changes in the production process, in the design or characteristics of the machinery, and in the harmonised standards, other technical specifications, or common specifications used to declare conformity) [condition: by reference to which the conformity of the machinery is declared] [REG, Art. 10(4)]
[18] Non-professional user — is not subject to — Article 10 manufacturer obligations (Article 10 manufacturer obligations) [condition: substantially modifies own machinery or related product for own use] [REG, Art. 18]
[19] the manufacturer — mustTakeMeasures — all measures necessary so that the manufacturing process and its monitoring ensure compliance of the manufactured machinery or related products with the technical documentation referred to in point 2 and with the applicable requirements of this Regulation (all measures necessary so that the manufacturing process and its monitoring ensure compliance of the manufactured machinery or related products with the technical documentation referred to in point 2 and with the applicable requirements of this Regulation) [REG, Annex VI, 3]
[20] manufacturer of partly completed machinery or authorised representative — shallKeepOriginal — declaration of incorporation for at least 10 years (declaration of incorporation for at least 10 years) [condition: from the last date of manufacture of the partly completed machinery] [DIR, Annex II, 2]
[21] Manufacturers — shallEnsure — partly completed machinery is accompanied by the EU declaration of incorporation set out in Annex V, Part B (partly completed machinery is accompanied by the EU declaration of incorporation set out in Annex V, Part B) [REG, Art. 11(8)]
[22] machinery or related product — mustBeDesignedToFacilitate — changing of worn parts (changing of worn parts) [REG, Annex III, 2.4.6.2]
[23] manufacturer or authorised representative — may apply internal checks on manufacture procedure in Annex VIII — machinery referred to in Annex IV and manufactured per harmonised standards under Article 7(2) (machinery referred to in Annex IV and manufactured per harmonised standards under Article 7(2)) [condition: standards cover all relevant essential health and safety requirements] [DIR, Art. 12(3)]
[24] manufacturer — shall determine — the limits of the machinery or related product, including intended use and any reasonably foreseeable misuse (the limits of the machinery or related product, including intended use and any reasonably foreseeable misuse) [REG, Annex III]
[25] manufacturer or authorised representative — shallApplyConformityProcedure — internal checks on the manufacture of machinery in Annex VIII (internal checks on the manufacture of machinery in Annex VIII) [condition: machinery is not referred to in Annex IV] [DIR, Art. 12(2)]
[26] Manufacturer of the machinery or related product — provideGuards — the appropriate guard(s) are provided by the manufacturer (the appropriate guard(s) are provided by the manufacturer) [condition: where splinter guards are fitted] [REG, Annex III, 2.2.2.1]
[27] substantial modification — requires — adoption of additional protective measures to ensure stability or mechanical strength (adoption of additional protective measures to ensure stability or mechanical strength) [condition: alternative to the requirement in point (a)] [REG, Art. 3(16)]
[28] substantial modification — requires — addition of guards or protective devices (addition of guards or protective devices) [condition: the processing necessitates modification of the existing safety control system] [REG, Art. 3(16)]
[29] Manufacturers — mustTakeCorrectiveActions — take corrective actions necessary to bring the partly completed machinery into conformity, withdraw it, or recall it, as appropriate (take corrective actions necessary to bring the partly completed machinery into conformity, withdraw it, or recall it, as appropriate) [condition: manufacturers consider or have reason to believe the partly completed machinery placed on the market is not in conformity] [REG, Art. 11(9)]
[30] Manufacturers — takeAccountOf — changes in the production process (changes in the production process) [REG, Art. 11(4)]
[31] Manufacturers — ensureProcedures — procedures are in place for partly completed machinery to remain in conformity with this Regulation (procedures are in place for partly completed machinery to remain in conformity with this Regulation) [condition: part of a series production] [REG, Art. 11(4)]
[32] importers — mustEnsureManufacturerComplies — requirements set out in Article 11(5), (6) and (8) (requirements set out in Article 11(5), (6) and (8)) [condition: before placing partly completed machinery on the market] [REG, Art. 14(2)]
[33] manufacturer of machinery or authorised representative — shallKeepOriginal — EC declaration of conformity for at least 10 years (EC declaration of conformity for at least 10 years) [condition: from the last date of manufacture of the machinery] [DIR, Annex II, 2]
[34] Manufacturer or authorised representative — mustTransmitInformation — relevant information about the partly completed machinery (relevant information about the partly completed machinery) [condition: in response to a reasoned request by national authorities] [ur10e-manual, p. 227]
[35] manufacturers of partly completed machinery — shallEnsure — partly completed machinery has been designed and constructed in accordance with the relevant essential health and safety requirements set out in Annex III (partly completed machinery has been designed and constructed in accordance with the relevant essential health and safety requirements set out in Annex III) [condition: when placing partly completed machinery on the market] [REG, Art. 11(1)]
[36] Manufacturer or Art. 18 person — shall apply — one of the procedures (a), (b) or (c) (one of the procedures (a), (b) or (c)) [condition: where the machinery or related product category is listed in Annex I, Part A] [REG, Art. 25(2)]
[37] manufacturer or authorised representative — shall determine — the limits of the machinery, including intended use and any reasonably foreseeable misuse (the limits of the machinery, including intended use and any reasonably foreseeable misuse) [DIR, Annex I]
[38] Manufacturers — shall take — corrective actions necessary to bring machinery or related product into conformity, to withdraw it or to recall it (corrective actions necessary to bring machinery or related product into conformity, to withdraw it or to recall it) [condition: manufacturer considers or has reason to believe the product placed on the market or put into service is not in conformity; "as appropriate] [REG, Art. 10(9)]
[39] Manufacturer or authorised representative — shall transmit — relevant information about the partly completed machinery (relevant information about the partly completed machinery) [condition: in response to a reasoned request by the national authorities] [ur5e-manual, p. 220]
[40] Manufacturers — shallIndicateOn — packaging or an accompanying document (packaging or an accompanying document) [condition: where marking the partly completed machinery is not possible] [REG, Art. 11(6)]
[41] manufacturer — ensuresAndDeclares — machinery or related product concerned satisfies the applicable requirements of this Regulation (machinery or related product concerned satisfies the applicable requirements of this Regulation) [REG, Annex VI]
[42] notified body — shall require — manufacturer to take appropriate corrective actions (manufacturer to take appropriate corrective actions) [condition: machinery or a related product is found to no longer comply during monitoring after an approval decision] [REG, Art. 38(4)]
[43] Machinery referred to in Annex IV — requires — manufacturer or authorised representative to apply one of the listed procedures (manufacturer or authorised representative to apply one of the listed procedures) [condition: machinery not manufactured in accordance with the harmonised standards referred to in Article 7(2), or only partly in accordance with them] [DIR, Art. 12(4)]
[44] Manufacturer of partly completed machinery or authorised representative — shall ensure that technical documentation is prepared — relevant technical documentation described in Annex VII, part B (relevant technical documentation described in Annex VII, part B) [condition: before placing the machinery on the market] [DIR, Art. 13(1)]
[45] Manufacturer of partly completed machinery or authorised representative — shall ensure that assembly instructions are prepared — assembly instructions described in Annex VI (assembly instructions described in Annex VI) [condition: before placing the machinery on the market] [DIR, Art. 13(1)]
[46] Chiunque venda, noleggi o conceda in uso o locazione finanziaria — attestaConformita — macchine, apparecchi o utensili (macchine, apparecchi o utensili) [condition: costruiti o messi in servizio al di fuori della disciplina di cui all'articolo 70, comma 1] [DLGS72, art. 72, c. 1]
[47] manufacturer or authorised representative — shallEnsure — Article 13 procedure has been completed (Article 13 procedure has been completed) [condition: before placing partly completed machinery on the market] [DIR, Art. 5(2)]
[48] Results of the new risk assessment — may require — the entity operating the machine to meet the obligations of a manufacturer (the entity operating the machine to meet the obligations of a manufacturer) [nanoscan3-manual, p. 21]
[49] Manufacturer of partly completed machinery or authorised representative — shall ensure that a declaration is drawn up — declaration of incorporation described in Annex II, part 1, Section B (declaration of incorporation described in Annex II, part 1, Section B) [condition: before placing the machinery on the market] [DIR, Art. 13(1)]
[50] Manufacturers — takeAccountOf — changes in the harmonised standards or other technical specifications (changes in the harmonised standards or other technical specifications) [condition: conformity is declared or verified by reference to them] [REG, Art. 11(4)]
[51] Manufacturers — takeAccountOf — changes in the common specifications referred to in Article 20 (changes in the common specifications referred to in Article 20) [condition: conformity is declared or verified by reference to them] [REG, Art. 11(4)]
[52] interchangeable equipment — isDefinedAs — a device assembled by the operator himself with machinery or a tractor after putting into service to change its function or attribute a new function (a device assembled by the operator himself with machinery or a tractor after putting into service to change its function or attribute a new function) [condition: not a tool] [DIR, Art. 2]
[53] removable mechanical transmission device — isDefinedAs — a removable component transmitting power between self-propelled machinery or a tractor and another machine at the first fixed bearing (a removable component transmitting power between self-propelled machinery or a tractor and another machine at the first fixed bearing) [condition: when placed on the market with the guard, it is one product] [DIR, Art. 2]
[54] partly completed machinery — isDefinedAs — an assembly almost machinery that cannot in itself perform a specific application and is only intended to be incorporated into other machinery (an assembly almost machinery that cannot in itself perform a specific application and is only intended to be incorporated into other machinery) [DIR, Art. 2]
[55] machinery — isDefinedAs — an assembly with a drive system other than directly applied human or animal effort, consisting of linked parts at least one of which moves, joined for a specific application (an assembly with a drive system other than directly applied human or animal effort, consisting of linked parts at least one of which moves, joined for a specific application) [condition: fitted with or intended to be fitted with a drive system] [DIR, Art. 2]
[56] authorised representative — isDefinedAs — a person established in the Community who has a written mandate from the manufacturer to perform obligations on the manufacturer's behalf (a person established in the Community who has a written mandate from the manufacturer to perform obligations on the manufacturer's behalf) [DIR, Art. 2]
[57] placing on the market — isDefinedAs — making machinery or partly completed machinery available for the first time in the Community with a view to distribution or use (making machinery or partly completed machinery available for the first time in the Community with a view to distribution or use) [condition: whether for reward or free of charge] [DIR, Art. 2]
[58] safety component — isDefinedAs — a component that serves a safety function, is independently placed on the market, and whose failure or malfunction endangers persons (a component that serves a safety function, is independently placed on the market, and whose failure or malfunction endangers persons) [condition: not necessary for machinery to function, or normal components may be substituted] [DIR, Art. 2]
[59] lifting accessory — isDefinedAs — a component or equipment not attached to lifting machinery that holds the load, placed between the machinery and the load or on the load, and independently placed on the market (a component or equipment not attached to lifting machinery that holds the load, placed between the machinery and the load or on the load, and independently placed on the market) [DIR, Art. 2]
[60] putting into service — isDefinedAs — the first use, for its intended purpose, in the Community, of machinery covered by the Directive (the first use, for its intended purpose, in the Community, of machinery covered by the Directive) [DIR, Art. 2]
[61] Person carrying out substantial modification — must apply — relevant conformity assessment procedure under Article 25(2), (3) and (4) (relevant conformity assessment procedure under Article 25(2), (3) and (4)) [REG, Art. 18]
[62] Person carrying out substantial modification — must comply with — Article 10 obligations in addition to conformity declaration duties (Article 10 obligations in addition to conformity declaration duties) [REG, Art. 18]
[63] Commissioning tests — mustBeConductedBefore — using the robot application for the first time (using the robot application for the first time) [condition: or after making any modifications] [ur5e-manual, p. 198]
[64] importer or distributor — isConsideredA — manufacturer (manufacturer) [condition: for the purposes of this Regulation] [REG, Art. 17]
[65] Manufacturer — compiledTechnicalDocumentationPerPartB — Part B of Annex VII of the Machinery Directive (Part B of Annex VII of the Machinery Directive) [ur10e-manual, p. 227]
[66] Autogrù Caterpillar gommata — manufactureYear — 1997 (1997) [igea-equipment, p. 9]
[67] Prestazioni dell'Appaltatore — sono riferite a — liste delle macchine/apparecchi aggiornate (liste delle macchine/apparecchi aggiornate) [condition: secondo il punto 2.4] [igea-equipment, p. 4]
[68] Appaltante — deve essere iscritto — nell'elenco dei soggetti abilitati (art. 2 comma 4 D.M. 11 aprile 2011) (nell'elenco dei soggetti abilitati (art. 2 comma 4 D.M. 11 aprile 2011)) [igea-equipment, p. 4]
[69] aggiudicatario — must respect — contents of this Scheda Tecnica (contents of this Scheda Tecnica) [igea-equipment, p. 5]

Fact [9] only excludes a non-professional user modifying their own machinery for own use, which does not answer the general question. The date is not relevant here.", "kind": "text", "value": "The natural or legal person who carries out the substantial modification is considered the manufacturer for purposes of the Regulation.", "text": "Under Article 18 of the Regulation, the natural or legal person who carries out a substantial modification is considered the manufacturer for purposes of this Regulation.", "used": [2]}
